cohort: 2,588 women who attempted trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC)
finding: Lower uterine segment thickness (LUST) is inversely correlated with gestational weeks and decreases faster in the first and second trimesters than in the middle and late third trimesters.
gest_age: First trimester (12.10 ± 1.28 weeks), second trimester (21.79 ± 3.40 weeks), middle third trimester (34.28 ± 2.64 weeks), and late third trimester (38.20 ± 1.00 weeks)
